hardware.why: the GPU stage L and R0 ran on: their timings are this plan's basis, and the 4B teacher plus a child and the stores fit

basis.setup_and_b_rebuild: d2_budget's reference-calibration components (R0's measured setup, stage L's measured B rebuild)

steps.what: pod setup, environment, teacher fetch and load
build the root reference store on BOTH calibration profiles at micro-batch 1 AND 3 (four builds), time them, compare the stores, and run teacher_confidence.validity_report on each profile
steps.why_gpu: the real teacher's full-vocabulary entropy distribution is the question; a toy has none
steps.gate: stores agree bsz1 vs bsz3 within R0's state tolerance (1e-5 abs on confidence); validity report written

steps.what: rebuild B exactly as stage L did, forward it over both profiles and record its per-position root KL; validity_report WITH that KL (Spearman(c_T, KL), weighted vs unweighted shares by span)
steps.why_gpu: the c_T-KL relation needs a real compressed student; B is the incumbent, the scale every D-series number is read against

steps.what: FFN, WIDTH and ATTENTION at the root, each with full-scope (weighted) and narrow-scope (unweighted) statistics: time both, record the selection overlap (kept neurons, projection subspace overlap, kept heads)
steps.why_gpu: how far the teacher's confidence moves a REAL selection is the full-scope effect size; the toy's is meaningless
steps.gate: both arms complete; overlap and timing recorded

steps.what: one DEPTH round on the FFN child from V3 (a non-root parent) under the D2 objective at all_v1: root-reference table, round-0 parent-KL diagnostic, objective and diagnostic seconds, both cache modes
steps.why_gpu: the reference change acts only below the root; its cost and the root-vs-parent ranking difference exist only on real activations
steps.gate: both references cached; the table and the parent ranking recorded

steps.what: the same DEPTH round at scored_v1
steps.why_gpu: the D2 scored_v1 equivalence for THIS objective (stage L's verdict covers the superseded one)
steps.gate: R0's tolerances: max relative 1e-5, same choice

steps.what: B under the D2 objective: all_v1 vs scored_v1, bsz1 vs bsz3, and KL-only for the overhead
steps.why_gpu: the per-evaluation overhead and the scored-rows equivalence of THIS objective on the real suite
steps.gate: R0's tolerance 1e-5 on every state.objective.* metric

deliverables: the root store's identities, content digests and build seconds (both profiles, bsz1 and bsz3)
the teacher-confidence validity report per profile, with B's KL
full- vs narrow-scope selection overlap and timing per operator
DEPTH root-vs-parent ranking on a non-root parent, with its cost
scored_v1 equivalence verdicts for THIS objective (DEPTH, state)
measured replacements for every PROVISIONAL term of the D2 search price (d2_budget.teacher_confidence_overhead)
does_not: change any definition: results are descriptive
evidence_contract: booked in logs/stages/stage-1/families/d_series/validations/d2-gpu-validation/v1/campaign.json with the evidence file's sha256; d2_budget.d2_validation_evidence reads it and nothing else, and the D2 authorization's scored_v1 gate reads that
